results.name: Bangalore Water Crisis
results.title: Bangalore Water Crisis
results.summary: Severe depletion of groundwater and failed monsoons led to a massive water shortage in Bangalore

macro_shifts.context: Severe depletion of groundwater and failed monsoons led to a massive water shortage in Bangalore

expected_impacts.reasoning: Tanker prices surged 3x to Rs 2000+ as borewells dried up across the city
Housing societies hiked monthly maintenance to cover exorbitant private tanker costs
Tenants began vacating severely affected IT corridors like Whitefield
Tech parks mandated work-from-home as office facilities ran out of water
Restaurants shifted to disposable plates and limited menus to save washing water

Severe lack of drinking water sources impacted urban fauna and stray dogs

pred_impacts.rationale: Severe groundwater depletion forces households to rely entirely on private water tankers, leading to skyrocketing costs and rationing.
Housing societies and apartments pass on the inflated costs of bulk water tanker procurement to residents via steep maintenance fee hikes.
Depleted aquifers yield muddy or hard water, and unregulated private tankers often supply unverified, poor-quality water to desperate citizens.
Reliance on contaminated tanker water and compromised daily hygiene due to severe scarcity increases the risk of waterborne infections like typhoid and cholera.
Eateries and street vendors face significantly higher operational costs for procuring clean water, leading to menu price hikes or temporary closures.

results.name: Real Money Gaming Ban (Online Gaming Act 2025)
results.title: Real Money Gaming Ban (Online Gaming Act 2025)
results.summary: After 28% GST in 2023, India passed the Online Gaming Act 2025 banning all real money games. 85% of $3.2B gaming revenue wiped, $840M write-downs, 7000+ layoffs across Dream11, MPL, WinZO and others.

macro_shifts.context: After 28% GST in 2023, India passed the Online Gaming Act 2025 banning all real money games. 85% of $3.2B gaming revenue wiped, $840M write-downs, 7000+ layoffs across Dream11, MPL, WinZO and others.

expected_impacts.reasoning: Direct target of the ban — all RMG platforms shut down operations, 450M users lost access overnight
MPL, WinZO, Gameskraft and others laid off 7000+ employees within weeks of the ban
Gaming streamers, esports pros, and fantasy sports influencers lost primary income source
States lost Rs 20,000 Cr annually in GST and income tax from the RMG sector
IPL and cricket sponsorship deals collapsed — Dream11, MPL were top sponsors. Reduced fan engagement without fantasy overlay
Government cited 450M affected Indians, addiction, financial ruin, and suicides as ban rationale. Post-ban: withdrawal and income-loss anxiety
Laid-off gaming employees entered gig economy, increasing supply and suppressing per-worker payouts

pred_impacts.rationale: The Online Gaming Act 2025 legally prohibits real money games, forcing immediate app takedowns and cutting off citizen access to fantasy sports and betting platforms.
The sudden wipeout of 85% of gaming revenue forces immediate, large-scale layoffs (7000+) across major tech startups like Dream11 and MPL.
Real money gaming companies were massive advertisers; their collapse eliminates a major source of sponsorship and ad revenue for digital creators and influencers.
